prose: OpenAI, Anthropic and other AI companies have vowed to protect Tuesday's US midterm elections from AI-enabled efforts to undermine democracy, per the New York Times. The piece looks at those efforts, including Anthropic's first-ever 'war room'.
highlights: OpenAI, Anthropic and others pledged election protection for the midterms
